newsitem.title: INDIA: Senior Janata Dal leader B. Patnaik dead -agencies.
newsitem.headline: Senior Janata Dal leader B. Patnaik dead -agencies.

text.p: Veteran Janata Dal party leader Biju Patnaik, former chief minister of the eastern Indian state of Orissa, died on Thursday in a New Delhi hospital, local news agencies said. He was 81.

United News of India said the politician had been suffering from a variety of ailments including bronchial asthma, pneumonia and respiratory problems. It was not known if the United Front Steering Committee would postpone a meeting set for later on Thursday due to Patnaik's death.
The United Front's decision-making meeting was scheduled to meet at 3 p.m. (0930 GMT) on Thursday to consider replacing caretaker H.D. Deve Gowda as the coalition's leader.
News agencies said Patnaik had recently been admitted to Escorts Hospital in the capital after his health began to deteriorate.
